messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Additive effect using the Two-part model
parts:
R/qtl doesn't have any facilities for calculating QTL effect estimates in the context of the two-part model.

I'd suggest defining the two separate phenotypes: binary trait indicating whether an individual has non-zero phenotype or not, and quantitative phenotype with missing values for the individuals with the 0 phenotype. Then use fitqtl to estimate the QTL effects with each of these phenotypes, one at a time, using model="binary" for the former and model="normal" for the latter.

karl
